component.name: Naga Zapret
component.summary: Modern Graphical Control Center for Zapret DPI Bypass
Zapret DPI Sansür Aşma Grafik Kontrol Merkezi

description.p: Naga Zapret is an intuitive desktop application built with Qt6 designed to bypass Deep Packet Inspection (DPI) censorship on Linux systems without requiring terminal commands or manual DNS configuration.

Naga Zapret, Linux üzerinde terminal komutlarına veya karmaşık DNS ayarlarına gerek kalmadan Discord, Roblox gibi servislere uygulanan DPI engellemelerini tek tıkla aşmanızı sağlayan Qt6 tabanlı modern bir kontrol merkezidir.

ul.li: Single-click automated installation and cleanup of the Zapret service
Live 10x packet connectivity diagnostics for Discord and Roblox
System tray integration with background health checks
